headline: Integrated omics resources link methylation, GWAS, expression and spatial data to context
label: Omics Knowledge Resource Databases
summary: Five 2026 database releases extend cancer methylation, GWAS, transcriptomic and spatial resources with analysis modules for expert reuse.
synthesis: The common thread across these five resources is integration: each joins heterogeneous data layers to a biological context and adds query or analysis functions over the curated store. MethMarkerDB 2.0 extends cancer DNA methylation biomarkers to 21 cancer types with CpG-level and functional analysis modules. scGWAS-DB links 3,649 GWAS datasets to single-cell atlases spanning 74 human tissues and 1,713 cell types, mapping gene-gene interactions. Gene Expression Nebulas 2.0 expands standardized transcriptomic profiles with manually curated annotations. iCellOmics connects genomic, transcriptomic and epigenomic profiles with literature-curated gene-phenotype evidence for 17 industrially relevant cell lines. CROST 2.0 reaches 544 spatial transcriptomics projects and 3538 samples with niche, colocalization and cancer-niche tools. What is new is resolution of biological context, from CpG sites and single-cell tissue states to spatial niches. Only scGWAS-DB explicitly maps gene-gene interactions, so network-based structure is not shared across the set.
